description: A deep check of the application by Mira, Visarun's application checker, the one Validate runs in the app, up to two minutes: contradictions between the answers, the documents, the trip and the chat that no rule catches, and corrections already checked against each field's rules. It changes no answer: save the proposals you accept with visarun_save_answers. visarun_validate_application is the fast check by rules alone.
name: visarun_run_mira_check
title: Deep-check an application
